metadata.description: rkmax's Claude Code plugins: the graph investigation skill, the harness verifier-first working loop, and the what-how request splitter.

plugins.name: graph
plugins.description: The Graph Blueprint: split a goal into pieces, fan out parallel worker agents with different angles, verify with a fresh-context verifier, merge what survives into one actionable report.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Verifier-first working loop for a live product: intake turns raw requests into verifiable work items, one bounded session per item, adversarial acceptance gate.

plugins.name: what-how
plugins.description: Separate a request's WHAT (the outcome wanted) from its HOW (the method it prescribes), clarify the WHAT, then choose whether the HOW is weighed, kept as advisory, or dropped before the work starts.
